instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: This week the team merged 14 pull requests across the auth and billing services. The auth service migrated its session store from cookies to signed JWTs, closing three long-standing security issues. The billing service added retry logic for failed webhook deliveries and fixed a rounding bug in invoice totals. Two contributors also updated the onboarding docs and added a new CI job that runs integration tests against a staging database on every merge to main.
gold: auth service migrated to signed JWTs
billing service added webhook retry logic
billing service fixed an invoice rounding bug

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: At 03:14 UTC the payments API began returning elevated 500 error rates after a database connection pool exhaustion. On-call was paged automatically and identified a recent deploy that removed a connection timeout as the root cause. The team rolled back the deploy at 03:41 UTC and error rates returned to baseline by 03:50 UTC. A follow-up ticket was filed to add a canary stage before future deploys touching connection pooling.
gold: payments API had elevated 500 errors from connection pool exhaustion
root cause was a deploy that removed a connection timeout
team rolled back the deploy and errors returned to baseline

instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: Over the past sprint the team shipped a new onboarding flow, reduced the Docker image size by 40 percent by switching to a slim base image, and migrated the analytics pipeline from cron jobs to a managed queue. They also deprecated the legacy v1 REST API and added rate limiting to the public endpoints to protect against abusive clients.
gold: shipped a new onboarding flow
reduced the Docker image size by 40 percent
migrated the analytics pipeline from cron to a managed queue

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: A memory leak in the image-resizing worker caused pods to be OOM-killed roughly every two hours starting Tuesday. Engineers traced it to an unbounded in-memory cache added in a recent refactor. They deployed a fix that caps the cache at 500 entries and added a dashboard alert on worker restart counts so a recurrence is caught within minutes.
gold: a memory leak caused image-resizing pods to be OOM-killed
root cause was an unbounded in-memory cache
the fix caps the cache and adds a restart-count alert

instruction: Summarize the meeting notes in one or two sentences.
input: In the planning meeting the team agreed to prioritize the mobile offline mode for the next release, postpone the desktop redesign to Q3, and hire two additional backend engineers. They also decided to move the weekly standup to Mondays and adopt a new bug triage rotation so no single person owns triage for more than a week.
gold: prioritized mobile offline mode for the next release
postponed the desktop redesign to Q3
agreed to hire two backend engineers

instruction: Summarize the release notes in one or two sentences.
input: Version 3.2 introduces end-to-end encryption for direct messages, adds support for scheduling posts up to thirty days in advance, and fixes a bug where large file uploads would silently fail. The release also improves cold-start time on Android by lazy-loading the media library and updates several third-party dependencies for security.
gold: introduces end-to-end encryption for direct messages
adds scheduling posts up to thirty days ahead
fixes silent failures on large file uploads

instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: This week contributors closed 22 issues, most of them flaky-test failures in the CI suite. The root cause was a shared test database that was not reset between runs, so the team introduced per-test transactions that roll back automatically. Test runtime dropped from nine minutes to four, and the flaky-failure rate fell to near zero.
gold: closed 22 issues, mostly flaky CI tests
root cause was a shared test database not reset between runs
introduced per-test rollback transactions, cutting runtime from nine to four minutes

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: The CDN began serving stale assets after a misconfigured cache header set the max-age to one week instead of one hour. Users saw an outdated logo and broken styles for several hours before it was reported. The team purged the cache, corrected the header, and added a linter rule that flags cache lifetimes longer than a day.
gold: the CDN served stale assets for several hours
cause was a cache header set to one week instead of one hour
team purged the cache and added a linter rule for long cache lifetimes

instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: The database team completed the migration from a single Postgres instance to a primary-replica setup, moving all read-heavy analytics queries to the replica. This cut primary CPU usage in half during peak hours. They also added connection pooling with PgBouncer to reduce connection churn and documented the failover procedure.
gold: migrated from single Postgres to a primary-replica setup
moved read-heavy analytics queries to the replica
added PgBouncer connection pooling

instruction: Summarize the meeting notes in one or two sentences.
input: Sales and engineering met to align on the enterprise roadmap. They committed to delivering single sign-on by the end of the quarter, agreed that audit logging is the top blocker for two large deals, and decided to run a security review before the next enterprise launch. Marketing will hold the launch announcement until the review passes.
gold: committed to delivering single sign-on this quarter
identified audit logging as the top blocker for two deals
decided to run a security review before the enterprise launch

instruction: Summarize the release notes in one or two sentences.
input: The 5.0 major release removes the deprecated callback API in favor of promises, requires Node 20 or later, and ships a rewritten scheduler that reduces idle CPU by 30 percent. A migration guide and a codemod are included to automate most of the upgrade, and the changelog lists every breaking change.
gold: removes the deprecated callback API in favor of promises
requires Node 20 or later
ships a rewritten scheduler cutting idle CPU by 30 percent

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: A third-party payment provider had a two-hour outage during which checkout failed for about eight percent of orders. The team had no fallback provider, so affected carts were queued and retried automatically once service resumed. A follow-up will evaluate a secondary provider to avoid a single point of failure.
gold: a third-party payment outage caused checkout failures for about eight percent of orders
there was no fallback provider
affected carts were queued and retried after recovery

instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: Contributors spent the week hardening the API gateway: they added request signing, moved secrets from environment variables to a managed vault, and enabled mutual TLS between internal services. A penetration test scheduled for next month will validate the changes, and the on-call runbook was updated accordingly.
gold: added request signing to the API gateway
moved secrets to a managed vault
enabled mutual TLS between internal services

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: A deploy that changed the timezone library caused all scheduled jobs to run one hour late for a full day before anyone noticed. The team reverted the library, backfilled the missed jobs, and added an end-to-end test that asserts job scheduling against a fixed clock so the regression cannot silently return.
gold: a timezone library change made scheduled jobs run an hour late for a day
the team reverted the library and backfilled missed jobs
added an end-to-end test against a fixed clock

instruction: Summarize the meeting notes in one or two sentences.
input: The design review settled three open questions: the team will adopt a single shared component library, drop support for Internet Explorer, and standardize on an eight-point spacing grid. Implementation will start after the current sprint, and the design system docs will be updated first.
gold: adopt a single shared component library
drop support for Internet Explorer
standardize on an eight-point spacing grid

instruction: Summarize the release notes in one or two sentences.
input: Release 2.4 adds offline caching so the app works without a connection, introduces biometric login on supported devices, and reduces the install size by removing unused fonts. Push notifications are now opt-in by default, and the settings screen was reorganized for clarity.
gold: adds offline caching for use without a connection
introduces biometric login on supported devices
reduces install size by removing unused fonts

instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: The frontend team migrated the build from Webpack to Vite, cutting local rebuild times from twelve seconds to under one. They also split the main bundle into route-based chunks, which lowered the initial JavaScript payload by 45 percent and improved the first-load score in Lighthouse.
gold: migrated the build from Webpack to Vite
cut local rebuild times from twelve seconds to under one
split the bundle into route-based chunks, lowering initial payload by 45 percent

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: An expired TLS certificate on the email service caused all outbound notifications to fail silently for six hours overnight. Monitoring only checked HTTP endpoints, not certificate expiry, so no alert fired. The team renewed the certificate and added automated expiry alerts thirty days ahead of expiration.
gold: an expired TLS certificate caused outbound emails to fail for six hours
monitoring did not check certificate expiry
team renewed the cert and added expiry alerts thirty days ahead

instruction: Summarize the meeting notes in one or two sentences.
input: Leadership approved the plan to open-source the core SDK, agreed to publish it under the Apache 2.0 license, and set a public launch date for the end of next quarter. Marketing will prepare a blog post and a documentation site, and legal will review contributor agreements first.
gold: approved open-sourcing the core SDK
chose the Apache 2.0 license
set a public launch for the end of next quarter

instruction: Summarize the release notes in one or two sentences.
input: The 4.1 update rewrites the notification center, adds keyboard shortcuts for every primary action, and fixes a long-standing bug that duplicated calendar events across time zones. Dark mode now follows the system setting automatically, and the onboarding tour can be replayed from settings.
gold: rewrites the notification center
adds keyboard shortcuts for every primary action
fixes duplicated calendar events across time zones

instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: The platform team introduced feature flags backed by a central service, letting product teams roll out changes to a percentage of users without a deploy. They migrated three existing hardcoded flags and documented a cleanup process to retire stale ones after a rollout completes.
gold: introduced feature flags backed by a central service
enabled percentage rollouts without a deploy
migrated three hardcoded flags and documented stale-flag cleanup

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: A runaway analytics query locked a core table for twenty minutes during peak traffic, slowing every write across the product. The team killed the query, added a statement timeout, and moved heavy analytics to a read replica to prevent a recurrence during business hours.
gold: a runaway analytics query locked a core table for twenty minutes
it slowed every write during peak traffic
team added a statement timeout and moved analytics to a read replica

instruction: Summarize the meeting notes in one or two sentences.
input: The retrospective surfaced that unclear ticket ownership was the biggest source of delay. The team agreed to assign an owner at grooming, cap work-in-progress at three tickets per person, and add a daily blocked-items check to standup so stalled work is escalated quickly.
gold: unclear ticket ownership was the biggest source of delay

input: Version 1.9 adds CSV and PDF export to every report, introduces role-based access control with three preset roles, and improves search with typo tolerance. The onboarding checklist is now dismissible, and the app remembers the last-used filters per report.
